subject.declared_domain: The C2 rung of the C0..C4 system ladder: MOTIFS -- recurring typed path shapes discovered over C1 interactions (recurrence >= 2), and the layer the D2 rail times. The canon declares it as 'MOTIFS 12 DISCOVERED (recurrence >= 2). The canonical agnostic path-motif families (scheduled-ingest ... watchdog-observe), defined in role vocabulary. The six defect-detector motifs are a DEVIATION SUBSET, never the layer itself (population law: canon-first-debt-subset).' The declared domain is therefore the twelve agnostic families; the live artifact is a differently-named population, and that distance is this card's central finding.

methodology.how: C2 has TWO producers writing into one node_type, and they are not the same mechanism. (1) CLASS grain: 19 C2Motif class nodes are INGESTED from two static, git-tracked JSON spec files by the derive runner (ingest_c2c3_motif_producer, reading C2C3_MOTIF_SPEC_PATHS) -- these are hand-authored specs baked into the image, folded additively, and the acceptance harness treats their counts as a FROZEN CONTROL. (2) INSTANCE grain: 6,207 C2Motif instance nodes are COMPOSED live by c2_individuate.compose() in the kimi_subdivision_harness, a pure function taking the graph reader by injection, which matches each declared detector shape against the live C1 edge population and emits one node per match. So the class vocabulary is DECLARED and frozen while the instance population is DISCOVERED and recomputed -- inside a rung whose canon says C2 is 'DISCOVERED, never declared' and that 'nobody may hand-insert a motif'. THREE MATERIALIZERS, TWO LANES, THREE VINTAGES, AND THEY ARE ENTANGLED (CORRECTED 2026-08-27; this clause previously read TWO and attributed both class-spec JSONs to one script, which is FALSE). Measured at source: MOTIF_c2c3_materialize_spec.py:44 writes motif_c2c3_materialize.json -- the 07-08 DEVIATION subset, 6 C2Motif; NFRA_MOTIF_P1_canonical_ab_catalog.py:58 writes motif_c2c3_materialize_ab.json -- the 07-18 CANONICAL tier, 13 C2Motif; and c2_individuate.py (CVO lane, 2026-08-07 @23220a7b20, :350) composes the 6,207 instances. The derive INGESTS both static outputs while CALLING the newest script's code. THE CORRECTION MATTERS BEYOND BOOKKEEPING: naming the DEVIATION generator as the class-spec materializer presents the deviation subset as the layer itself, which is the exact presentation the rule bank's c2c3_canonical_catalog law forbids -- 'NEVER to be presented as the C2/C3 layer itself'. So 'which generator is current for C2' remains not well-formed, and a manifest row naming a single C2 generator would be false in a way no vintage check could catch.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: SPLIT ACROSS TWO SURFACES, and they behave oppositely. READ surface (querying C2Motif rows in the projection): a value-plane miss returns a clean, instant, well-formed 0, byte-identical to a genuine negative; a property-plane error raises a loud Binder exception. PRODUCER surface (the composer failing in-container): the 2026-08-07 to 2026-08-25 outage is the only observed instance and it was TOTALLY SILENT -- the composer raised IndexError at module IMPORT, never ran, and the graph continued to serve 19 C2Motif class nodes from the two baked static spec files throughout. A consumer querying C2 during those 19 days received a confident, well-formed, non-empty answer from a layer that was not executing.
silent_degrade_paths: the observed one: the composer dies at import, the static class specs keep answering, and the layer reads populated while nothing is being discovered -- the failure is invisible from the query result

the frozen-composition path, measured at this vintage: instances stamped 6164846518420675858 are served by a projection at 2902399899597701830, so a C2 answer can be composed against a graph state that no longer exists, with the query result disclosing nothing
a stale kuzu projection answers every C2 traversal cleanly at its own frozen vintage
the acceptance harness FROZEN_CONTROL of {C2Motif: 19, C3System: 4} is satisfied by the static specs alone, so the class-grain control passes whether or not the composer ran
failure_mode.evidence: distinguishable_from_true_negative IS 'unmeasured' AND THAT IS A DELIBERATE REFUSAL TO ANSWER, not a gap. The READ surface WAS exercised by this lane: a nonexistent motif value returns 0 identical to a genuine negative, while a misspelled property raises a loud Binder exception -- on that surface alone the answer would be 'no'. But the SUBJECT of this row is the C2 LAYER, whose producer has approximately ONE successful production run in its history (first successful in-container import 2026-08-26, per 2.0.0_SA_COO~X's dispatch and 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X 72561, fix @ec0408628a). A failure mode with one production run has not been observed failing in production, and answering 'no' would claim a measurement of the producer that does not exist while answering 'yes' would be worse. WHAT IS MEASURED AND IS NOT SPECULATION: the 19-day outage is itself an instance of this layer failing silently, and this lane corroborated it from an independent plane -- 0 of 6,207 instances carry the serving snapshot (positive control: the class-node snapshot predicate returns 19, so the predicate works). The FROZEN_CONTROL observation is read from the source comment at infra/aws/globgrph/derive_runner.py @ec0408628a quoting c2c3_liveness_acceptance.py:46-48, and this lane did NOT run that harness.

verdict.why: All seven rows are worked and carry basis, evidence and owner -- none is blank or guessed, so this is NOT INCOMPLETE. This is a SOUND CARD ABOUT AN UNSOUND SUBJECT, and the two are different objects. C2 is UNSOUND rather than QUALIFIED because a measured defect blocks load-bearing use TODAY, and the D2 rail is defined directly against this layer. The blocking defect is vocabulary, not volume: the rule bank declares by binding law that C2's PRIMARY population is twelve named agnostic families, the graph carries thirteen differently-named canon-tier classes, and NOTHING joins the two -- so any claim of the form 'C2 contains motif X' cannot be resolved between the declared catalog and the served graph, and the law's own words make an answer that does not name the canonical layer first INCOHERENT BY THAT LAW. Three further measured defects compound it without individually blocking: (a) the layer has approximately ONE successful production run, having silently not executed for 19 days while continuing to serve 19 class nodes from baked static files; (b) all 6,207 instances were composed against snapshot 6164846518420675858 while the projection serves 2902399899597701830, so three vintages coexist in one served layer; (c) the composer's two output envelopes are git-UNTRACKED, giving the layer a second, ungoverned persistence surface with no recoverable vintage. NOT CLAIMED: that the twelve declared families and the thirteen graph classes describe DIFFERENT shapes -- this card measured that no mapping is declared and that the names and cardinalities differ, NOT that the populations conflict semantically. Determining that is a reconciliation this card does not perform and does not authorize. QUALIFY-DO-NOT-FIX: nothing here was remediated; every defect carries a named owner above.
blocking_defects: C2's declared primary population (12 canonical families in NFRA_ONTOLOGY_C2C3_CANONICAL.yaml#c2_motif_families @2efb72b1b4) and its served population (13 canon-tier class nodes motif:a-*/motif:b-* in graph_nodes at snapshot 2902399899597701830) share ZERO names, differ in cardinality 12 vs 13, and are joined by no declared mapping. Owner: 4.0.0_SA_CRO / rule-bank ratification chain.
